source: Maui County Youth Canoe Paddling Audit

clubs.name: Hawaiian Canoe Club
clubs.place: Hoaloha Park, Kahului Harbor · 1 E. Kaʻahumanu Ave.
clubs.description: A community rooted in waʻa, teamwork and Hawaiian culture, with age-group racing and Kamaliʻi enrichment. Older youth can also grow through the Youth Leadership Program.
clubs.opportunity: Youth regatta racing, cultural enrichment and leadership for ages 14–18.
clubs.season: 2026 youth practices began May 4. Contact the club for current practices and next-season dates.
clubs.registration: Contact the club for youth registration information. Ask about the right age group, practice times and dues.
clubs.contact: Club office; HCRA primary contact Kaʻili Moikeha
clubs.extra: The published age groups are reproduced as listed; families of nine-year-olds should ask the club which group applies.

clubs.name: Kīhei Canoe Club
clubs.place: North Kīhei; confirm the meeting point with the club.
clubs.description: A junior racing pathway, plus a Saturday Keiki Paddling Program that continues beyond the summer regatta season.
clubs.opportunity: Youth racing with Saturday MCHCA regattas and an HCRA state-championship pathway; separate recurring keiki sessions.
clubs.season: Youth racing: April 6–August 1, 2026 (past). Keiki sessions are listed into fall 2026.
clubs.registration: Contact the club for youth registration information. Published 2026 racing dues were $60, including one race jersey; practice and race paddles were supplied. Ask about next-season fees and keiki-session requirements.
clubs.contact: Alexis Goddard · youth racing / keiki program
clubs.extra: 2026 racing practices were afternoons in April–May and mornings in June–July. The October 10 keiki listing runs 9–11 a.m., is categorized Member Youth Program and says registration is not required; ask about membership and first-time participation before attending.

clubs.name: Nā Kai ʻEwalu
clubs.description: Paddling, mentoring and Hawaiian cultural education come together in a club that fields crews from young paddlers through kūpuna.
clubs.opportunity: MCHCA regatta competition, distance paddling and youth mentoring; eligibility for specific distance crews should be confirmed.
clubs.season: Regatta season April–August; distance season August–October. Confirm current youth practices.
clubs.registration: Contact the club for youth registration information. Ask about fees, swimming requirements and practice schedules.
clubs.extra: The club explicitly hosts Baldwin High School and Kamehameha Schools Maui during the MIL season. This relationship does not establish practice arrangements for other schools.

clubs.name: Wailea Canoe Club
clubs.place: South Maui; contact the club for the youth meeting point.
clubs.description: Structured youth age groups sit within a club serving young paddlers, their families and the wider community.
clubs.opportunity: Competitive and recreational paddling; MCHCA and HCRA youth competition.
clubs.season: 2026 summer-regatta practices began May 4. Contact the club for current practices and next-season dates.
clubs.registration: Contact the club for youth registration information. The program page lists youth coaches; ask which group fits your child.

clubs.name: Hāna Canoe Club
clubs.description: A local paddling home for East Maui families, with youth membership explicitly listed and a connection to the Sarah Joe Memorial Regatta.
clubs.opportunity: Youth club participation and regatta community; ask which crews and beginner groups are currently available.
clubs.season: The club took part in 2026 racing. Contact the club for youth practice dates.
clubs.registration: Contact the club for youth registration information. The community directory lists youth membership at $25 and a required swim test; ask whether the fee is still current. Coaches and parent volunteers are sought.
